title: Embedding modes, explicit base-B addressing, and length extrapolation
question: Across the step-harnessed variants (`cls`, `step_fork`, `step_ar`, `addressed_step_ar`) and pure-LM `ar` / `addressed_ar` (`input_ids` only), how do section-coupled sinusoidal `position_ids` (`token_type_pe`), `token_type_ids` alone (`token_type_nope`), causal masking alone (`nope`), and explicit base-B column addresses (`addressed_step_ar`, `addressed_ar`, both defaulting to `nope`) compare on in-domain convergence speed vs. zero-shot extrapolation to longer operands (`L = 21..40`)?
